# TeachMeAnatomy

> > A comprehensive online anatomy learning platform featuring interactive 3D models, 1,800+ exam-style MCQs, spaced-repetition flashcards, and cadaveric spotters for medical education.

TeachMeAnatomy is a medical education platform designed to help students master human anatomy through multiple interactive learning modalities. The site combines foundational anatomy reference content with practical exam preparation tools, covering all major body regions and systems with clinical context.

## Key Topics

- TeachMeAnatomy Pro
- 3D Interactive Models
- Question Bank
- Flashcards
- Clinical Anatomy
- Cranial Nerves
- Spinal Cord
- Anatomical Structures
- Surgical Anatomy
- Medical Education
- Spaced Repetition
- Cadaveric Spotter
- Exam Preparation
- Skeletal System
- Interactive Learning

## Core Learning Tools

- [TeachMeAnatomy Question Bank](https://teachmeanatomy.info/question-bank): 1,800+ anatomy MCQs across multiple regions for exam preparation and medical education
- [3D Human Anatomy Models](https://teachmeanatomy.info/3d-model): Interactive 3D full-body anatomy models for regional and systemic learning
- [Flashcards](https://teachmeanatomy.info/flashcards): Spaced-repetition flashcard study tool for anatomy learning with deck creation
- [Cadaveric Anatomy Spotter Assessment](https://teachmeanatomy.info/spotter): High-fidelity cadaveric spotter assessment for practical anatomy exam preparation

## Anatomical Reference Sections

- [Basics of Human Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/the-basics): Foundational anatomy concepts: terminology, tissues, joints, embryology, imaging
- [Neuroanatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/neuroanatomy): Neuroanatomy reference: brain, spinal cord, cranial nerves, functional pathways
- [Head Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/head): Head anatomy reference: skull, cranial nerves, facial muscles, blood supply
- [Thorax Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/thorax): Thorax anatomy: lungs, heart, rib cage, mediastinum, vessels, pleura
- [Neck Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/neck): Neck anatomy: cervical vertebrae, muscles, vessels, nerves, glands, fascia
- [Back Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/back): Back anatomy: vertebral column, spinal cord, muscles, ligaments, fascia
- [Upper Limb Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/upper-limb): Upper limb anatomy: shoulder, arm, forearm, hand with nerves and vessels
- [Lower Limb Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/lower-limb): Lower limb anatomy: hip, thigh, leg, foot with clinical insights
- [Abdomen Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/abdomen): Abdominal anatomy: wall, peritoneal cavity, viscera, surgical landmarks
- [Pelvis Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/pelvis): Pelvic anatomy: pelvic bones, organs, floor, perineum, clinical anatomy

## Learning Guides

- [How to Learn Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/the-basics/learning-anatomy): Step-by-step guides for learning muscles, bones, joints, nerves, vessels
- [How to Learn Bone Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/the-basics/learning-anatomy/bones): Step-by-step guide for learning bone anatomy: site, shape, attachments
- [How to Learn Muscular Anatomy](https://teachmeanatomy.info/the-basics/learning-anatomy/muscles): Framework for learning muscular anatomy: site, shape, action, classification

## Premium Features & Account

- [TeachMeAnatomy Pro](https://teachmeanatomy.info/sign-up): TeachMeAnatomy Pro subscription signup with 3D models, quizzes, and flashcards
- [My Account Flashcards](https://teachmeanatomy.info/my-account/flash-cards): User account flashcards dashboard for spaced-repetition anatomy study
